description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for managing CCSP component registration, discovery, session management, and parameter handling within a Cisco RDK environment. It includes test functions for these features, as well as utility functions for memory and resource management.

methods.name: PrintoutStatus
methods.description: Prints a string message corresponding to a status code, optionally appending a newline.

methods.name: CRSessionTest
methods.description: Tests session management functions of the CCSP CR manager, requesting and releasing sessions with different priorities.

methods.name: CRFreeComponent
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an array of namespace type structures.

methods.name: CRRegisterTest
methods.description: Performs registration tests for various component capabilities, including handling of version mismatches and object levels.

methods.name: CRCheckDataTypeTest
methods.description: Checks data type validation functions for different namespace strings and data types.

methods.name: CRDiscoverTest
methods.description: Performs discovery of components supporting specific namespaces and parameters, with various nextLevel and object path scenarios.

methods.name: CRUnregisterTest
methods.description: Tests unregistration of namespaces and components, then re-registers components for further tests.

methods.name: CRComponentTest
methods.description: Retrieves and displays registered components and their namespaces.

methods.name: AnscTraceMemoryUsage
methods.description: Placeholder for tracing memory usage; currently empty.

methods.name: CRBatchTest
methods.description: Runs a sequence of tests including session, registration, discovery, and cleanup, with memory and resource tracking.

methods.name: BaseApiTest
methods.description: Tests parameter name retrieval and value fetching for components under specified root names.
